newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's BBV says studying share nominal cut.
newsitem.headline: Spain's BBV says studying share nominal cut.

text.p: Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya (BBV) is studying a cut in the nominal value of its shares from the current 575 pesetas, a spokesman for BBV said on Tuesday.
"We're aiming to reduce the nominal to 500 pesetas eventually, and the subject of a further move after last year's 25 pesetas (cut) is open as a possibility," the spokesman said.
This would represent cash returned to shareholders as the payment is tax free.
The matter was likely to be discussed at a management meeting before being presented to the shareholders' meeting on February 22, he said.
